scope.included: Fashion-relevant brands for women, men, kids, intimates, activewear, accessories/headwear and footwear from the audited department stores. Brand existence is tracked independently from sizing-chart availability.
scope.excluded: Home-only, beauty-only, furniture, cookware and electronics brands unless they also participate in a fashion category.

status_definitions.verified_loaded: One or more compatible verified sizing charts are live in BrandSizeChart.
status_definitions.partial: Sizing source exists but is incomplete, fit-family-specific, malformed or otherwise unsafe to generalize.
status_definitions.estimate_only: Brand is available in the master catalog but no compatible verified chart is live; body-measurement estimates remain available.
